name: Renja
source:
She lives on the top floor of Sayoko’s apartment building. The whole floor.
She cannot walk, but through talent and smarts she has made a fortune selling sweets.
For some reason, she has an almost morbid fixation on Sayoko, who has once happened to help her out.
